name: Dorei Koujo Ria
source:
A great power Faeolen sits in the center of Allegra continent. Its military power and leadership of prince Alex made this country prosperous. But no one could guess what happened in palace dungeons. Princess and successor to the throne is confined and tampered with. Her fate depends only on one person.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-october-2007-boku-ga-sadame.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
强国法奥伦坐落在阿莱格拉大陆中央。强大的军力，加上亚历克斯王子的领导，令这个国家繁荣昌盛。然而，没有人能够猜到王宫地牢里正发生着什么。身为皇女与王位继承人的莉娅遭到囚禁和玩弄，而她的命运只掌握在一个人手中。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-october-2007-boku-ga-sadame.html]vndbreview[/url]]
